accepted.name: Ilo
accepted.claim: The Estonian Sports Register lists exact Ilo Tomberg as the badminton federation representative on the Estonian Olympic Committee from 29 April 1997 to 21 November 2001. Cached Wikidata P19/P17 row identifies birthplace Tallinn (Q1770); geographic country association, not inferred nationality. Sports administrator is mapped to public_figure, not athlete.
